name: GRIEVANCE
note: GRIEVANCE, IN BLACK (doc 05: 'in the hearse harness, wearing black well'). The mule in her black plume and harness, hitched to the hearse (a prop, room-31-hearse); cut from room-31's composition master by tools/art/room31-cast.py with the strip of hearse beside her, which never moves -- her actions move her head only (errata 99 G).

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, in the hearse harness · 1 an ear goes back · 2 her head goes down · 3 her head turns away from the hill. A break every `breakEvery` seconds (errata 77).
